entries.clue: Officialese for getting down from a bus at your chosen stop
Political self-destruction; in Japan, a fatal stroke to one's own belly
Rolled-thin casing that wraps a pie or holds a jam tart
Crumbly, buttery round layered up with summer strawberries
Person behind the wheel of the bus you have just boarded
Ribbed device of iron and paper, raised by a commander to order the advance
Coins you drop in the tray as you climb aboard the bus
Tiered case of nested boxes on a cord, carried at the waist for pills
Two uprights and two crossbeams, often painted red, marking sacred ground
Small slip that spools out of the machine as you board a bus
Flat Italian bake poked full of dimples, oiled and strewn with rosemary
Domain granted to a lord and rated by the rice it could yield in a year
Plain Indian round cooked dry on a hot griddle, with nothing to raise it
Signed way out, often a separate door partway along the bus
